kevin: Heads-up—I'm drafting a short relnotes blurb for Adaptive routing beta. Need: tiny whats-new, one-line migration tip, known-issue note, and two snippets (curl + python). Will open PR in ~20m and ping for quick review.

rami: Include exact config key: adaptive_routing.enabled. Add fallback chain: hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-variant. Ops wants canary plan: 10% 24h -> 50% 48h.

nora: I'll add the curl + python snippets and a one-liner for the changelog feed (<=80 chars). Also will include a repro for the T4 KV-warmup blip.

ci-bot: PR #5077 created (preview): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing/preview-5077. Linkcheck: 1 404 (/tutorials/legacy-routing).

kevin: Added redirect /tutorials/legacy-routing -> /docs/adaptive-routing/migrate and short migration tip: "Pre-warm KV or ramp traffic if you use route-level caching." Draft blurb: 

What's new — Adaptive routing (beta)
- Opt-in via adaptive_routing.enabled = true; prefers cost-efficient variants and automatically falls back to compatible variants.
- Canary: 10% for 24h, 50% for 48h.
Known issue: On some T4 hosts, seq=512 can show a transient ~5-12ms latency while KV cache warms. Repro: ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-canary.

rami: LGTM. I'll watch release-index and add changelog feed entry after merge.
